title: CompletionRequest
description: POST /api/connectors/completion (HEL-955 design.md D5) -- the anonymous/optional-auth submission that binds a credential to a pending Connector. Token and credential travel in the BODY only, never the query string. Every failure mode (unknown/expired/consumed/superseded token, wrong owner, empty/invalid credential, encryption failure) returns the same byte-identical curated refusal -- this endpoint is not an existence oracle.
